description: List posts of the API key's workspace (JSON with items, total, limit, offset; each item carries targets[] with channel, accountId and status, and needsReschedule on the post and each target, so the same caption on several networks is one post per network, not a duplicate; a WORDPRESS target carries its article summary but not the body: use get_post for contentHtml), optionally filtered by status (draft, scheduled, paused, publishing, published, failed, missed_slot: scheduled posts approved after their time, or still unapproved past it, that will not auto-publish until the user picks a new time; plain scheduled excludes them), channel, brandId and a scheduledAt range (from/to).

channel.description: Only posts that have a target on this channel (UPPERCASE canonical, lowercase accepted).

from.description: scheduledAt lower bound, ISO 8601 with zone.

status.description: Only posts with this status, e.g. FAILED, PAUSED or MISSED_SLOT (case-insensitive).

to.description: scheduledAt upper bound, ISO 8601 with zone.

name: list_posts
title: List posts
